tables.name: Publisher
tables.where: publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "Journal" WHERE journal_id IN (SELECT journal_id FROM "Volume" WHERE volume_id IN (SELECT volume_id FROM "Issue" WHERE issue_id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM "Article" WHERE article_id IN (SELECT article_id FROM (SELECT article_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY publication_year ORDER BY article_id ASC) AS rn FROM "Article" WHERE is_deleted = false AND reference_count > 0 AND publication_year IN (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)) ranked_articles WHERE rn <= 3000) AND issue_id IS NOT NULL) AND volume_id IS NOT NULL) AND journal_id IS NOT NULL) AND publisher_id IS NOT NULL)
